Prasann hriday mehnat ko naach me badal deta hai.
Buddhi pake hue dimaag ka phool hai.
Buddhi jail ko vicharon ka mahal bana deti hai.
Shaanti se khaya gaya sadhan bhojan bhi tyohaar hai.
Aatma vichaaron ka chehra pahne.
Ahankari jahaj ahem ki ek lahar me doobta hai.
Caesar bhi ziddi ahankar nahi jeet sakta.
Ek chatur jeebh talwar ki dhaar par naachti hai.
Ek chatur tippani sangmarmar ke smarak se zyada chalti hai.
Samajhdar manushya kinare par kudne se pehle dekhta hai.
Manushya bhramon ka shikari hai.
Dimaag ek aisi riyasat hai jahan parchhaiyon ka raaj hai.
Nadi se mat lado; tairna seekho.
Teekhi buddhi sabse tez barbaadi se aage nikal jaati hai.
Rooh chupchaap ladi ladaiyon ke zakhm pehnti hai.
Khud ko jaanana hi devataon par vijay hai.
Khamoshi mein teekhe vicharon ka toofan chhipa hota hai.
Gyan galtiyon ki parchhayi mein badhta hai.
Ek chatur jawabi hamla dimaag ka dwand hai.
Baanta gaya dukh aadha bojh halka kar deta hai.
Chalak khoji moorkhata ko hawa ki tarah use karta hai.
Chalak jubaan ek taakatwar samrajya hai.
Jahaj jab bandar-gah mein ho tab mat aakho.
Tez dimaag sabse tez rath se bhi aage nikal jata hai.
Manav disha suchak hamesha ichchha ki or ishara karta hai.
Gyaani vyakti kisi bhi cheez ki ati nahi karta.
Hum aakash napte hain, par zameen par thokar khate hain.
Satya ko kisi bhesh ki aavashyakta nahi.
Buddhi jaagte hue dimaag ki roshni hai.
Chalak dhokebaaz har hawa ke sath chalta hai.
Ek teekhi baat gusse ki bheed ko shant kar deti hai.
Jo ujaale se bhage, chhaya unka peecha kare.
Man chhaaiyon ka rangmanch hai.
Ek chatur chaal gardan ko rassi se bachati hai.
Buddhi sabse andhere ghanton mein chamakti hai.
Log satya khojte hain, par bhram ko apnate hain.
Aandhi par muskurayein aur vah guzar jaaye.
Har deewar ek intezaar karti darwaaza hai.
Jaise hum aage badhte hain, dimaag ka kshitij peeche hatta hai.
Ek teekha jawab ek sena ke barabar hota hai.
Man uthal-puthal samudra jaisa hai.
Jo toofaan se dare, wah kabhi antareep nahi dekhega.
Satya shaant beech mein mile.
Hansi nirasha ke khilaf sabse achha kavach hai.
Buddhimaan wahan hansta hai jahan moorkh rota hai.
Ek prasann baat sabse andhere hisse ko roshan karti hai.
Ek chatur jawab apmaan ke khilaf kavach hai.
